facts.value: Deferred admission allows you to start at ASU in a later semester than the one you were originally admitted to.

metadata.chunk_title: What is deferred admission?

facts.value: Admission is guaranteed to the university, but not necessarily to your original major or program.

facts.value: You may request a deferment.

metadata.chunk_title: What is deferred admission?

facts.value: One year for most other students including international students on an F-1 visa.

metadata.chunk_title: What is deferred admission?

facts.value: You cannot attend another college or university during your deferment.
